f3_program: collection("keiko.sent_text_messages", "text_message", "keiko", source("Keiko sent 111 text messages last week"))
observe(at("keiko.sent_text_messages.count", "last_week"), 111, "count", source("Keiko sent 111 text messages last week"))

offset(at("keiko.sent_text_messages.count", "this_week"), scale(at("keiko.sent_text_messages.count", "last_week"), 2), -50, "count", source("This week she sent 50 less than double what she sent last week"))
query("sum", "keiko.sent_text_messages", "last_week_and_this_week")
assumptions: The combined query spans the explicitly named last-week and this-week periods.

f3_program: observe(at("christine.items_sold.value", "this_month"), 24000, "dollar", source("she sold $24000 worth of items"))
percent_of(at("christine.commission_earnings", "this_month"), at("christine.items_sold.value", "this_month"), 12, source("She gets a 12% commission on all items she sells"))

percent_of(at("christine.commission_earnings.personal_needs", "this_month"), at("christine.commission_earnings", "this_month"), 60, source("Sixty percent of all her earning will be allocated to her personal needs"))

difference_relation(at("christine.commission_earnings.saved", "this_month"), at("christine.commission_earnings", "this_month"), at("christine.commission_earnings.personal_needs", "this_month"), source("the rest will be saved"))
query("value", at("christine.commission_earnings.saved", "this_month"))
assumptions: “All her earning” refers to Christine's commission earnings, and “the rest” is the portion not allocated to personal needs.

f3_program: observe(at("beehive_wax.candle_making.beehives.required.count", "reference"), 3, "count", source("3 beehives"))
observe(at("beehive_wax.candle_making.candles.count", "reference"), 12, "count", source("12 candles"))

quotient_relation("beehive_wax.candle_making.candles_per_beehive", at("beehive_wax.candle_making.candles.count", "reference"), at("beehive_wax.candle_making.beehives.required.count", "reference"), source("It takes 3 beehives to make enough wax to make 12 candles"))
observe(at("beehive_wax.candle_making.candles.count", "target"), 96, "count", source("96 candles"))

quotient_relation("beehive_wax.candle_making.candles_per_beehive", at("beehive_wax.candle_making.candles.count", "target"), at("beehive_wax.candle_making.beehives.required.count", "target"), source("How many hives does it take to make 96 candles?"))
query("value", at("beehive_wax.candle_making.beehives.required.count", "target"))
assumptions: “Hives” and “beehives” are coreferential, and the stated candle-per-beehive relation applies to the target candle quantity.

f3_program: collection("small_zoo.animals", "animal", "small_zoo", source("A small zoo houses a variety of 68 wild animals"))
observe(at("small_zoo.animals.count", "initial"), 68, "count", source("68 wild animals"))

transfer("gorilla_family_transfer", "small_zoo", at("small_zoo.animals.count", "current"), at("gorilla_destination_zoo.animals.count", "current"), 6, source("they send a gorilla family of six to a different zoo"))

transfer("hippopotamus_adoption", "small_zoo", at("hippopotamus_source_zoo.animals.count", "current"), at("small_zoo.animals.count", "current"), 1, source("they adopt a hippopotamus from another zoo"))
add("endangered_rhino_intake", "small_zoo", at("small_zoo.animals.count", "current"), 3, source("the zoo took in three endangered rhinos"))
produce("lion_cub_birth", "small_zoo.lioness", at("small_zoo.animals.count", "current"), "small_zoo.lion_cubs.born.count", source("one of their lionesses gave birth to cubs"))

add("meerkat_exhibit_opening", "small_zoo", at("small_zoo.animals.count", "current"), scale(event_field("lion_cub_birth", "quantity"), 2), source("they opened a meerkat exhibit with twice as many meerkats as they had gained lion cubs"))
observe(at("small_zoo.animals.count", "then"), 90, "count", source("The zoo then had 90 animals in all"))
query("value", event_field("lion_cub_birth", "quantity"))
assumptions: “They” and “their” refer to the small zoo, and the gained lion cubs are those produced by the lion-cub birth event.

f3_program: observe(at("fish_sales.earnings_per_mass", "current"), 20, "dollar_per_kilogram", source("earning $20 per kg of fish"))

multiple(at("erica.fish.caught.mass", "today"), at("erica.fish.caught.mass", "past_four_months_excluding_today"), 2, source("catches twice as many fish as she caught in total in the past four months"))
observe(at("erica.fish.caught.mass", "past_four_months_excluding_today"), 80, "kilogram", source("Erica trawled 80 kg of fish in the past four months, not including today"))

sum_relation(at("erica.fish.caught.mass", "past_four_months_including_today"), at("erica.fish.caught.mass", "past_four_months_excluding_today"), at("erica.fish.caught.mass", "today"), source("in the past four months including today"))
same(at("erica.fish.sold.mass", "past_four_months_including_today"), at("erica.fish.caught.mass", "past_four_months_including_today"), source("assuming she sells all her fish"))

rate_relation(at("erica.fish_sales.earnings", "past_four_months_including_today"), at("fish_sales.earnings_per_mass", "current"), at("erica.fish.sold.mass", "past_four_months_including_today"), source("earning $20 per kg of fish"))
query("value", at("erica.fish_sales.earnings", "past_four_months_including_today"))
assumptions: The contextual fish-sale rate applies to Erica, and the requested period combines the stated four-month quantity excluding today with today's catch.
